name: Hand Over
summary: Remove a teammate, pick who takes their tasks and watch the task cards fly across to them
about: Hand Over is a remove-member flow that never leaves work behind. Pressing remove on a teammate opens a drawer that counts their open tasks and lets you pick who takes them. Confirming fans the task cards out of their avatar and flies them one by one to the new owner, whose count ticks up with a gold ring; then their seat floats out of the avatar stack and the row folds away. Undo replays it all in reverse.
how: Press the remove icon on a teammate to open the hand-over drawer.
Pick who gets their open tasks (arrow keys move between people).
Press Remove and the task cards fly to the new owner, then the row folds away.
Press Undo (or Ctrl+Z) to bring the person and their tasks back; Escape or Cancel closes the drawer.
